<!-- Source page: NixOS on MIPS -->

The last state of setting up NixOS on MIPS is documented on [in the old wiki on archive.org](https://web.archive.org/web/20120306042246/https://nixos.org/wiki/Multiplatform_NixOS), however the documentation is horribly outdated and you will have a hard time reproducing the steps.

Should you really want to try, the needed system tarball for the Fuloong mini-pc is distributed as a [torrent](magnet:?xt=urn:btih:d8b6179c79f5defa3102dd6cb11ded1f876050b9&dn=nixos-system-mips64el-linux-86c1e10-86e5e52.tar.xz)

This page is a place holder for the future support.
